title: Attendance deletion / eligibility flip
description: Remove attendance for enrollment 1: 75% becomes 0%, YES becomes NO; the outer rollback restores the row.
sql: WHAT_IF DELETE FROM attendance WHERE enrollment_id = 1;

title: Mark update / weighted demonstration GPA
description: Change enrollment 1 score to 45. Recompute credit-weighted score and demonstration GPA; audit rows also roll back.
sql: WHAT_IF UPDATE marks SET score = 45 WHERE enrollment_id = 1;

title: Enrollment deletion / foreign-key cascade
description: Delete enrollment 1 and observe one attendance row and one mark row cascade within the snapshot.
sql: WHAT_IF DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE enrollment_id = 1;

title: Drop score / catalog dependencies
description: Inspect views and triggers, attempt DROP COLUMN, and explicitly preview CASCADE if RESTRICT blocks it; restore the schema.
sql: WHAT_IF ALTER TABLE marks DROP COLUMN score;

title: Safety rejection / COMMIT
description: Reject transaction control before opening a database connection.

title: Read-only baseline verification
description: Read restored live GPA and score. The tests separately compare full table and catalog fingerprints across simulations.
sql: SELECT student_id, student_name, weighted_average_score, weighted_gpa FROM student_performance WHERE student_id = 1001;
